ideas.title: Uncovering the Scope of Minnesota's Fraud Investigation
ideas.description: Investigate the extent of the fraud that led to the USDA's suspension of $130 million in federal funds to Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Follow the money trail to identify entities and individuals involved.
questions: What is the estimated amount of fraud?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to expose a large-scale fraud scheme and uncover those responsible.
